title: Canonical coefficient and geometric square maps for Frobenius comparison
statement: In the purity setting of [def-pur-conventions], use the actual coefficient-stage comparisons of [def-pur-kappa-coefficient-stage-comparisons]. For any map $u_0:T'_0\to T_0$ of separated finite-type $k_0$-schemes, let $u:T'\to T$ be its base change. Both Frobenius maps commute with $u$. Define the finite square maps $UH_T\simeq H_{T'}U$ and $UG_T\simeq G_{T'}U$ by the inverse derived compositor, transport along the actual equality of scheme maps, and the derived compositor of [lem-trf-derived-pullback-coherence]. Define the integral square by the recorded normalized integral compositors of [lem-trf-integral-pullback-comparison-realization], its rational square by scalar localization, and its common-stage square by every finite-field representative. Define also the whole sequence-site Frobenius comparison by its ordinary evaluation-normalized finite maps, and its geometric square by the actual sequence-site compositors, retaining all transitions as in [lem-pur-normalized-pullback-composition-transport]. The coefficient comparisons are exactly those of [lem-fix-operation-reduction]: the actual finite quotient ring map, or the integral natural isomorphism whose components are the recorded integral scalar comparison. The identity uses [lem-pur-proetale-derived-pullback-identity]; successive pullbacks use the actual base-changed composite and its canonical compositor. No comparison isomorphism is input data. The sequence-site map realizes to exactly the specified completed comparison under that same normalized whole-system realization, including its representative counits. The constructible realizations of the integral compositors are the existing maps of [def-trf-realized-pullback-comparisons], specialized to these Frobenius squares.
